query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM users) AS total, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE last_login_at IS NOT NULL) AS logged_in, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE email_verified) AS verified, (SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE mfa_enabled) AS mfa, (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE event = 'on_new_session' AND created_at >= $1) AS active_sessions
